description:
Configure auto-compound for your Pillar wallet. When enabled, a keeper automatically boosts when sBTC accumulates above the trigger. Agent-signed, no browser needed. Backend sponsors gas.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

minSbtc.description: Minimum sBTC to keep in wallet (in sats)

trigger.description: sBTC amount above minimum that triggers auto-compound (in sats)

name: pillar_direct_auto_compound
